question: What class of results is being indicated here by an open enumeration rather than by a single named attainment?
premises: City-entering, possession, subjugation, and attraction are listed.
An open marker extends the list beyond those named.
The items share the class of practical attainments seen in preceding verses.
inference: City-entering, possession, subjugation, attraction, and similar results form an open class of attainments.
uncertainties: The full extent of items marked 'etc' cannot be determined from this verse alone.
plain_english: City-entering, possession, subjugation, attraction, and so on.
